basic_profile.bio: A self-proclaimed tech geek and audiovisual enthusiast, hailing from Melbourne, Australia. I spend my evenings tinkering with retro gaming setups and exploring the intricacies of CRT technology. I work as a systems analyst by day and delve into creative writing on Wattpad by night. Happily single, I enjoy the freedom to pursue my hobbies, and you'll often find me active on Reddit during late-night hours when the rest of the city sleeps.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of consumer electronics, especially vintage audio-visual equipment, acquired through years of self-teaching and community engagement. My expertise is also supported by a formal education in Computer Science, which I occasionally apply in my professional life.
